title: Synchrophasor: allow configuration sharing between streams
description:
TCP streams can be used to setup configuration used in UDP streams.
This change allows these configurations to be used between them.
To this end a Synchrophasor specific conversation is defined, between
the (usually IP) endpoints combined with an ID to uniquely identify
the conversation, where the configuration information is attached to.

Fixes #21459
